item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch group strikes against the logistics facilities of Ukraine and maritime vessels operating in the interests of the Ar
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch group strikes against the logistics facilities of Ukraine and maritime vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 📍 During the day, strike drones hit following targets in Kiev region: ▫️ DHL Logistik logistics centre in Pogreb, where warehouses were used to store unmanned aerial vehicles of various types and components for them. ▫️ Zammler depot shopping and logistics centre in Borispol, which is used to store and distribute military supplies supplied to the Armed Forces of Ukraine by Western countries. 📍 In Odessa region, strikes were delivered at a logistics centre in Nerubayskoye, which was used to store and distribute military cargo delivered to the port of Odessa. 💥 In addition, one dry cargo ship with military materiel for the Armed Forces of Ukraine was hit in the port of Yuzhny. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 'Even from the basements, we take them out and destroy. There is no mercy for them'
item.description: 'Even from the basements, we take them out and destroy. There is no mercy for them' 💬 Unmanned systems battalion serviceman with the call sign 'Bely' told how our lads liberated Annovka in the Donetsk People's Republic. ▫️ The operation was performed out of central casting. Experienced commanders led assault groups into the settlement during the night, and UAV operators actively covered their comrades from heavy Ukrainian copters. ▫️ The enemy hid the UAV command posts in the residential buildings of Dobropolye and tried to strike back, but Russian drones forced AFU servicemen to go out even from fortified basements. ↗️ The liberation of Annovka opened the Tsentr Group's servicemen a direct path to Dobropolye and a further way to the borders of the Donetsk People's Republic. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation. Russian troops launched strikes at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit close to Grushevka, Andreyevka, Prokopovka (Kharkov region), Karpovka, Rubtsy, and Lozovoye (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The enemy losses amounted to more than 190 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and 12 motor vehicles. ↗️ The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line. item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29128

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Nikolskoye, Kiyanitsa, and Ulanovo (Sumy region).
💥
In Kharkov region
, strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade close to Pisarevka, Slatino, Izbitskoye, Prikolotnoye, and Sosnovy Bor (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 245 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, and eight motor vehicles.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian troops launched strikes at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit close to Grushevka, Andreyevka, Prokopovka (Kharkov region), Karpovka, Rubtsy, and Lozovoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 190 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and 12 motor vehicles.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Formations of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade were defeated near Kramatorsk, Novoselovka, Klinovoye, Slavyansk, Kondratovka, and Druzhkovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 205 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 28 motor vehicles, and seven artillery guns, including one U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one jaeger brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Fedorovka, Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic) and Ivanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 370 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
